GenTileFromSpr0.name: Block and sprite helpers: berries and silver coins
summary: Starts with the GenTileFromSpr0 entry: generates the block in A at the current sprite's position (A = block number).
Then CODE_02B9BD: silver P-switch effect, turns every alive sprite without bit 6 of tweaker $190F into a silver moving coin (sprite $21).
Then CODE_02B9FA: Yoshi berry pick-up. Looks up the map16 tile at the position [$00]/[$08] (X), [$01]/[$09] (Y); if it is a berry
tile ($45-$47) spawns a berry (mushroom sprite $74) there and replaces the tile with the tree behind it. Sets [$18D6] = berry type.
Quirk: the vertical-level lookup at ADDR_02B9FE is unreachable because [$0F] is always cleared first.

s02BB0B.name: Table: Yoshi wing X and Y offsets

YoshiWingsSize.name: Table: Yoshi wing sizes, then draw Yoshi wings
summary: Table of OAM size bits, followed by the routine that draws one wing tile on Yoshi's back in extended OAM slot $F8.
Parameters: A: wing frame (0 or 1); X: sprite index of Yoshi. Draws nothing when Yoshi is off-screen.

s02BB88.name: Table: dolphin acceleration and speed limits

DolphinMain.name: Dolphin main routine
summary: Main routine for the dolphin sprites ($41, $42 horizontal; $43 vertical). Draws, moves, applies gravity, floats in water and
launches the dolphin out of the water at the end of each swim. Acts as a platform Mario can stand on (InvisBlkMainRt).
Quirk: the frame counter mask $00 means gravity applies every frame.

DolphinTiles3.name: Table: dolphin tile 3, then draw dolphin
summary: Table of the third dolphin tile, followed by CODE_02BC00 (vertical dolphin graphics) and CODE_02BC14 (horizontal dolphin graphics).
The horizontal dolphin is three 16x16 tiles, X-flipped when moving right, animated by the frame counter.

s02BC8F.name: Table: wall-follower speeds and masks
summary: Per-state tables for the wall-following sprites: movement speeds, probe speeds, blocked-direction masks, Spike Top frames and flips.

WallFollowersMain.name: Wall-follower sprites main and Spike Top graphics
summary: Shared main routine of Spike Top ($2E), the Urchins ($3A-$3C) and the ground-guided Fuzzball/Sparky ($A5) and Hothead ($A6).
Draws the sprite by type, kills it when not in normal status, otherwise interacts with Mario and runs the movement code.
[$1558] is an eye/face timer, randomly set to $0C about once in 256 frames.

UrchinPtrs?.name: Urchin states and wall-following movement
summary: Starts with a two-entry state pointer table for the Urchins: state 0 waits, state 1 moves and bounces off walls.
CODE_02BDA7 and CODE_02BDB3 then implement wall-following for Spike Top, wall-follow Urchin, Fuzzball/Sparky and Hothead: states 0-3 loop
one way around a surface, states 4-7 the other way, turning when the surface ends or a wall blocks the way.

s02BE4E.name: Fuzzball/Sparky and Hothead graphics
summary: Draws the ground-guided Fuzzball/Sparky ($A5, one 16x16 tile with a replaced tile and properties) and falls into the Hothead drawing.

HotheadTiles.name: Hothead tables and graphics
summary: Tables for the Hothead body and eye, followed by CODE_02BEB5, which draws four 16x16 body tiles in a 2x2 square and an 8x8 eye tile
whose position depends on the state (the side of the surface it is on).

s02BF49.name: Table: Urchin tile offsets and properties

UrchinTiles.name: Urchin graphics
summary: Table of Urchin spike tiles, followed by CODE_02BF5C: animates the Urchin and draws five tiles (center eye plus four spikes).
